title: Venue Review
description: VERIFY-stage producer artifact. One persona's mutually blind review of a manuscript against a frozen venue rubric. This is evidentiary advice only: it carries no verdict, meets_bar, decision, status, or accept field. After all reviews finish, the area chair emits venue_meta_review and the deterministic layer derives an advisory readiness screen. additionalProperties:false makes reviewer self-decision structurally impossible.

persona.description: Which reviewer persona produced this review.

venue_id.description: The venue this review is calibrated to (e.g. NeurIPS-2025, MICCAI-2025).

dimension_scores.description: Per-dimension scores (D1..D7). Each present key maps to a score + evidence. Keys not applicable to the venue/paper_type may be omitted.

reject_triggers_fired.description: List of reject-triggers that fired during this review. Empty if none fired.

dimension.description: The dimension this trigger maps to.

locus.description: Specific location in the manuscript where the trigger fires (section/figure/table reference).

required_fix.description: Concrete change needed to resolve this trigger.

overall.description: Overall recommendation mapped to the venue's own scale (e.g. 'Weak Accept', 'Reject', 'Strong Accept').

confidence.description: Reviewer confidence: 5=every claim checked, 1=uncertainty high. Low confidence votes are down-weighted by area-chair-synthesizer.

evidence_ref.description: Anti-slop guard: at least one evidence pointer (file path, artifact id, section ref) is required.

minimal_fix.description: Optional: the smallest change set that would make this review's reject triggers resolvable.

evidence_ref.description: At least one pointer (file:line, [[slug]], metrics path) justifying the score.
